metrics.originalImprovement: Make them discoverable and test complete normal-user journeys on target devices.

baseline.finding: Hosted snapshot links can be revoked; downloaded images are correctly described as irreversible.

metrics.currentImplementation: Hosted snapshots can be revoked; historical match dates and snapshot creation dates are distinct. Public links expose no newer rating number. Downloaded PNGs remain external copies.
metrics.requiredEvidenceOrWork: Player teach-back of hosted versus copied sharing, and public-cache/device review.
metrics.acceptanceCriterion: Revoked links stop exposing the snapshot and users understand downloaded copies remain.
metrics.originalImprovement: Keep the distinction clear and improve link management visibility.

baseline.finding: An independent review mechanism exists; staffing, response expectations and evidence handling are not an operational service yet.

metrics.currentImplementation: Independent reviewer tools and audit records remain; no staffed live service is provisioned.
metrics.requiredEvidenceOrWork: Named support owner, response target, escalation, appeal and staffing trial.
metrics.acceptanceCriterion: Real disputes are resolved within a stated, measured service expectation.
metrics.originalImprovement: Define a fair review workflow, escalation path and support ownership.

baseline.finding: Singapore districts, English copy and adult-only access limit a globally distributed audience.

metrics.currentImplementation: Global declared-location pools replace the Singapore-only restriction; English, adult-only pilot boundaries remain explicit.
metrics.requiredEvidenceOrWork: Launch-market decision, translations, spelling/locality normalization, support ownership and verified geography are still unresolved.
metrics.acceptanceCriterion: The launch audience can use the core location, language and identity workflows naturally.
metrics.originalImprovement: Choose a coherent initial market and communicate it, then localize using verified demand.

baseline.finding: A single-instance pilot and bounded synchronous replay do not establish creator-launch capacity.

metrics.currentImplementation: File-backed rating replay and encrypted push processing run in a background worker. Prepared/batched projections, consistent dashboard read snapshots and an actor-bound invalidating cache reduce repeated work. A local synthetic read/replay benchmark is provided.
metrics.requiredEvidenceOrWork: Hosted read/write/signup burst tests, continuous-ledger replay retry behavior, distributed limits and larger evidence bounds remain. This is still a single-instance SQLite pilot.
metrics.acceptanceCriterion: Expected launch demand preserves responsive scoring, approval and browsing.
metrics.originalImprovement: Load-test realistic cohorts, isolate replay work and remove inappropriate pool caps before scaling.

baseline.finding: Backups, replay and job retry exist, but no public hosting, monitoring or incident service is demonstrated.

metrics.currentImplementation: Worker health, bounded restart, queued retry, publication race guards and graceful close are implemented. Existing backup/replay tools remain.
metrics.requiredEvidenceOrWork: Actual hosted restore, alerting, incident staffing, deployment/container and real-device delivery drills.
metrics.acceptanceCriterion: A failure is detected, communicated and recovered without silent rating corruption.
metrics.originalImprovement: Verify deployment, restore drills, alerting and owner response before a broad release.

baseline.finding: The existing 15 test groups and three browser journeys cover only a slice of the consumer experience.

metrics.currentImplementation: All original criteria are retained with null new scores and explicit remaining proof.
metrics.requiredEvidenceOrWork: Independent reviewers and real-player evidence must establish acceptance; no self-issued 9.5.
metrics.acceptanceCriterion: Acceptance covers visible quality, full workflows and real behavior rather than passing a few happy paths.
metrics.originalImprovement: Add realistic-data review, device testing, player studies and outcome measurement.

outcomeMetrics.definition: Share of new players who get one correctly published result
outcomeMetrics.method: Track start, submission, approvals and publication; distinguish sessions from players.

outcomeMetrics.definition: Share reaching reveal in their preferred category
outcomeMetrics.method: Measure elapsed days and abandonment stage, not just account creation.

outcomeMetrics.definition: Time from joining to the first benefit the player actually recognizes
outcomeMetrics.method: Combine task timing with user explanation of value.

outcomeMetrics.definition: Share of submitted valid results reaching required approval
outcomeMetrics.method: Separate ordinary, retrospective, guest and corrected results.

outcomeMetrics.definition: Time until each required player responds and the result publishes
outcomeMetrics.method: Report median and upper-tail delays; distinguish notification delivery.

outcomeMetrics.definition: Share recording correct sides and scores without help
outcomeMetrics.method: Measure errors, corrections and completion time on real phones.

outcomeMetrics.definition: Share correctly explaining category independence and partner effects
outcomeMetrics.method: Use concrete examples rather than agreement with a leading question.

outcomeMetrics.definition: Independent target-player perception of quality
outcomeMetrics.method: Blind comparative review of complete journeys, not one curated screenshot.

outcomeMetrics.definition: Useful returns without an experimenter prompt
outcomeMetrics.method: Distinguish checking, approval, sharing and playing-associated returns.

outcomeMetrics.definition: Return behavior in clearly defined player cohorts
outcomeMetrics.method: Publish the retained-activity definition and account for weekly playing cadence.

outcomeMetrics.definition: Continued evidence, useful checking or group activity over eight weeks
outcomeMetrics.method: Segment active-playing players, quiet weeks and category preference.

outcomeMetrics.definition: Subsequent useful activity after a published loss
outcomeMetrics.method: Compare like-for-like players and contexts; avoid assigning causation from raw cohorts.

outcomeMetrics.definition: Voluntary use of supported comparisons and lead-change information
outcomeMetrics.method: Measure relevant rival views and returns without inventing activity.

outcomeMetrics.definition: Share of genuine earned moments voluntarily shared
outcomeMetrics.method: Separate download, copied link and confirmed downstream use.

outcomeMetrics.definition: Invited players reaching their own first useful value
outcomeMetrics.method: Track the actual invitation chain and privacy-preserving referral context.

outcomeMetrics.definition: Useful repeated playing links inside a launch group
outcomeMetrics.method: Measure active confirmed relationships, not friend counts alone.

outcomeMetrics.definition: Actual purchase at a clearly stated price
outcomeMetrics.method: Run real offers with representative players rather than interpreting likes as demand.

outcomeMetrics.definition: Retention of paying cohorts with recorded reasons
outcomeMetrics.method: Observe more than initial trial conversion or founder supporters.

outcomeMetrics.definition: Agreement between modeled probabilities and held-out outcomes
outcomeMetrics.method: Evaluate Singles, Doubles and Mixed separately, including scoring formats, relevant subgroups and uncertainty.

outcomeMetrics.definition: Near-duplicates, suspicious clusters, reports and review cost
outcomeMetrics.method: Measure actual incidence, false positives, decisions and time to resolution.

outcomeMetrics.definition: Player satisfaction after a complete normal session
outcomeMetrics.method: Collect CSAT alongside the reason, outcome and device; avoid founder-led prompting.

outcomeMetrics.definition: Perceived effort of scoring, approving and finding useful information
outcomeMetrics.method: Use a short CES question after actual tasks and compare with measured errors and time.

outcomeMetrics.definition: Likelihood of recommending SHUTTL to another relevant player
outcomeMetrics.method: Collect NPS with reasons and invitation behavior; NPS alone does not establish growth.

outcomeMetrics.definition: Response to losing access among players who experienced core value
outcomeMetrics.method: Segment established active players and record what benefit would be missed.

outcomeMetrics.definition: Unique meaningful active players within daily, weekly and monthly windows
outcomeMetrics.method: Define activity explicitly; compare ratios with the cohort's real playing cadence.

outcomeMetrics.definition: Share of paying members or revenue lost in a stated period
outcomeMetrics.method: Separate voluntary cancellation, failed payment, downgrade and ordinary non-playing weeks.

outcomeMetrics.definition: Share of appropriately timed trials becoming genuinely paid subscriptions
outcomeMetrics.method: Observe actual charges, activation and later renewal; do not count card entry as conversion.

outcomeMetrics.definition: Billing failures, refunds and recovery of legitimate subscription access
outcomeMetrics.method: Track cause, time to resolve, player communication and accidental access loss.

outcomeMetrics.definition: Period revenue per active user and per paying user
outcomeMetrics.method: Use matching periods and denominators; distinguish gross billings, net revenue and refunds.

outcomeMetrics.definition: Attributable acquisition cost per newly activated or paying player
outcomeMetrics.method: Include creator campaign costs and distinguish channels; views are not new customers.

outcomeMetrics.definition: Observed or explicitly modeled net contribution from a player cohort
outcomeMetrics.method: Include retention uncertainty and support, review and service costs; avoid an unsupported lifetime forecast.

outcomeMetrics.definition: Revenue remaining after relevant variable delivery and support costs
outcomeMetrics.method: Measure payment fees, hosting, review, support and any paid content or coaching delivery.

outcomeMetrics.definition: Invitations per activated player and activation of unique recipients
outcomeMetrics.method: Identify actual referral chains without double-counting an existing group's overlapping invitations.

outcomeMetrics.definition: View, click, visit, signup, first result, reveal, payment and renewal progression
outcomeMetrics.method: Use clear channel attribution and unique-player denominators; combined followers may overlap.

outcomeMetrics.definition: Loading, interaction, submission, approval and publication latency
outcomeMetrics.method: Measure median and high-percentile behavior on ordinary devices and real networks at launch load.

outcomeMetrics.definition: Share of core sessions without an unrecovered application failure
outcomeMetrics.method: Track frontend failures and backend errors by device, action and release.

outcomeMetrics.definition: Unassisted task success with relevant assistive technology and enlarged text
outcomeMetrics.method: Run complete scoring, approval, sharing and account-control journeys on target devices.

outcomeMetrics.definition: Time and quality of account, scoring, consent and dispute support
outcomeMetrics.method: Track first response, resolution, reopening and satisfaction without assuming every report is dishonest.

outcomeMetrics.definition: Predictive and experience quality across play categories and relevant cohorts
outcomeMetrics.method: Test network density, uncertainty, partner patterns and skill ranges without unjustified claims of equivalence.

outcomeMetrics.definition: Restore time, integrity and recoverable loss after a simulated failure
outcomeMetrics.method: Perform a separate restore drill and reconcile approved ledger, identities and published ratings.
